newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch central bank allocates fresh liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Dutch central bank allocates fresh liquidity.

text.p: The Dutch central bank said on Friday it had allocated 2.05 billion guilders ($1.1 billion) to the money market under a seven-day special advances pact at an unchanged rate of 2.50 percent.
Individual banks received 9.5 percent of the amount they had applied for, with the central bank setting a ceiling of 2.5 billion guilders on applications.
The new pact replaces a seven-day facility of 2.93 billion guilders that expired today.
